technical.summary: Mixed technicals with long-term uptrend structure but overbought short-term conditions, negative money flow, and no triggered entry signal limit swing trade probability.

fundamental.summary: UDR shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signals, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk in 54 days.

sentiment.summary: Market fear (30 score) presents contrarian opportunity, but stale congressional activity (114+ days old) and absent recent news sentiment provide minimal conviction support.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: VIX in crisis territory (401.76), flat yield curve signalling recession risk, NFP event in 1 day, and real estate sector vulnerable to credit stress and rising rates; earnings in 54 days adds moderate event risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Price above 200-EMA with supertrend and hull bullish signals provide long-term uptrend structure; contrarian sentiment opportunity in fear zone.
debate.key_bear_argument: Overbought short-term conditions (stochrsi, williams_r), negative money flow (CMF -0.191), no triggered entry signal, zero fundamental conviction, and severe macro headwinds (VIX crisis, flat yield curve, credit stress) create asymmetric downside risk in vulnerable real estate sector.

decision.entry_rationale: Not applicable — skip signal. Bear case dominates with overbought technicals, negative money flow, zero fundamental conviction, and severe macro headwinds outweighing long-term uptrend structure.
decision.primary_risk: VIX crisis environment combined with flat yield curve and credit stress creates asymmetric downside risk in real estate sector; earnings event in 54 days adds event risk during vulnerable macro window.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — technical, fundamental, risk, and debate agents all align on bear dominance; sentiment provides only weak contrarian offset.
